def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set(); frames=[]; objs=[]
    for y in range(h):
      for x in range(w):
       c=grid[y][x]
       if not c or (y,x) in seen: continue
       st=[(y,x)];seen.add((y,x));pts=[]
       while st:
        a,b=st.pop();pts.append((a,b))
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
         p,q=a+dy,b+dx
         if 0<=p<h and 0<=q<w and (p,q) not in seen and grid[p][q]==c:seen.add((p,q));st.append((p,q))
       ys=[a for a,b in pts];xs=[b for a,b in pts];y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
       bh,bw=y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
       border={(y0,x) for x in range(x0,x1+1)}|{(y1,x) for x in range(x0,x1+1)}|{(y,x0) for y in range(y0,y1+1)}|{(y,x1) for y in range(y0,y1+1)}
       if set(pts)==border: frames.append((c,y0,y1,x0,x1))
       else: objs.append((c,pts,y0,x0,bh,bw))
    for c,y0,y1,x0,x1 in frames:
     ih,iw=y1-y0-1,x1-x0-1
     # pair by same dimension, including potentially rotated pattern
     opts=[o for o in objs if (o[4],o[5]) in ((ih,iw),(iw,ih))]
     if not opts: continue
     _,pts,sy,sx,oh,ow=opts[0]
     for y,x in pts:
      dy,dx=y-sy,x-sx
      if (oh,ow)==(iw,ih): dy,dx=dx,dy
      if 0<=dy<ih and 0<=dx<iw: out[y0+1+dy][x0+1+dx]=c
    return out
PY
